name: earth.affine/affine-earth-math-court-remote
title: Affine.Earth Courts — Math, Quantum, Code
description: One MCP connector for every Affine.Earth court: exact-integer courts that verify a presented instance - a math claim (math_court, one tool for every court domain from geometry to minecraft; an empty domain returns the catalog, and the catalog's domain_count - copied below under catalog.domain_count with the date it was read - is the count, never a number in this text), a quantum-circuit witness (the QC verifiers), a key pair (verify_presented_pair, bond_presented_key), a flight plan (atc.assert_4d_deconfliction), a sentence in 25 languages (affine_translate_text) or a compiled artifact (code_ir_equiv; execute_artifact_crucible, which seals a posted wasm module and returns it byte-exact) - and answer WIN, MISS or a refusal that names what is missing. Every number is a decimal string or an exact integer; floats are refused. The tools list below is generated from the served tools/list by cells/xcode/scripts/ci/capability-registry-parity.sh --regenerate and held equal to the registry by that gate.

catalog.source: tools/call math_court {domain: ""} on the same local court the tools list was read from; rewritten by capability-registry-parity.sh --regenerate
